name: Release Please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  release-please:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Release Please
        uses: google-github-actions/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
